_comment: Bonds and companion opinions (BondManager.gd). Bonds: as a companion's rapport crosses each tier, a short scene plays the next time you visit the Tavern; the last tier unlocks a duo tech (a Link skill you use when that companion fights beside you). Opinions: companions in your party react to your choices by trait (rapport changes).
_opinions: event -> {trait: rapport change}. Events: press_on, breather, omens (per Omen taken), boss_win, help_wounded, refuse_wounded, confront_thief, let_thief_go, challenge_done.
_scenes: trait -> one line per tier ({name} = the companion). A scene uses the companion's first trait that has lines, else the default.

default: {name} lingers after the others leave. "You fight like someone with something to prove. I like that."
Over a late meal {name} tells you about the village they left, and why they can't go back.
"Whatever's down there," {name} says, "we face it together." You clasp hands. Something has changed between you.
reckless: {name} shows you a scar from a fight they "definitely won". You're not sure they did.
{name} admits charging in is easier than waiting: waiting is when the fear catches up.
"Next time I run at something huge," {name} grins, "you're right behind me. Deal?"
cautious: {name} has mapped every floor you've cleared together, in tiny careful handwriting.
{name} lost a party once, to one bad call. They've checked every corner twice since.
"I trust your calls," {name} says quietly. From them, that's everything.
ambitious: {name} wants their name on the Guild's wall. They ask how high you plan to climb.
{name} confesses the rank matters less than proving a sneering old mentor wrong.
"When they carve our names," {name} says, "they'll carve them side by side."
greedy: {name} counts their share twice, then grudgingly buys the next round.
{name} sends half of every purse home to a family that doesn't know where it comes from.
{name} slides a coin across the table. "Lucky coin. Keep it. Don't tell anyone I'm sentimental."
loyal: {name} stood guard all night without being asked. "Habit," they shrug.
{name} once served a lord who left them to die. They swore never to follow anyone unworthy again.
"I've chosen," {name} says simply. "Where you go, I go."
honorable: {name} returns a coin purse you dropped, untouched, with a lecture about carelessness.
{name} tells of an oath broken by their order. They left rather than share the shame.
"You keep your word," {name} says. "So will I - to you, whatever comes."
cowardly: {name} jumps at every shadow, but they haven't left yet. That counts for something.
{name} admits they joined the Guild on a dare and never found the nerve to quit.
"I'm still scared," {name} says, "but less, when it's you beside me."
kind: {name} spends their wages on bread for the street children by the Guild hall.
{name} was a healer's apprentice who couldn't save someone. They fight so fewer people need saving.
"You're a good person," {name} says. "Don't let this work change that. I'll remind you."
cruel: {name} laughs at a fallen goblin. You wonder what made them like this.
{name} grew up in the fighting pits. Mercy was a thing that got you killed.
"I don't do friends," {name} mutters - then stays by your side all night anyway.
lazy: {name} is asleep in the corner. Somehow they still beat you at cards later.
{name} admits they're tired because they never stop worrying. Sleep is just... easier than thinking.
"For you," {name} yawns, "I might even get up early." High praise.
cheerful: {name} has a song for every floor. Most of them are terrible. You hum along anyway.
{name} smiles because the alternative is remembering too much. They tell you a little of it.
"You made me laugh for real," {name} says. "Not the act. Thank you."
aloof: {name} answers with one word. Then, unprompted, a second. Progress.
{name} tells you about the stars their people navigate by, and which one is theirs.
{name} sits beside you without being asked. For them, that's a speech.
devout: {name} prays before every descent. They pray for you too, you notice.
{name} lost their faith once, in the dark below. It was a stranger's kindness that brought it back.
"The gods sent me to you," {name} says, without a trace of doubt.
scholarly: {name} is cataloguing monster weaknesses in a battered notebook. They let you peek.
{name} was expelled from the academy for a theory everyone laughed at. The dungeon is proving it right.
"Co-authors," {name} says, writing your name beside theirs on the notebook's cover.
boastful: {name} tells the tavern about "their" boss kill. You were there. It went differently.
{name} admits the bragging started because nobody noticed them as a child.
"Fine," {name} sighs, "it was OUR boss kill. You can have half the song."

_duo_techs: Duo tech by the companion's class: a Link skill (costs link_cost) you use while that Bonded companion fights beside you. It hits like a skill and pulls the companion forward to act next. Fields are skill fields.

Paladin.name: Oathbound Strike
Paladin.description: You strike as your Paladin raises a sacred ward.

Cleric.name: Benediction Blade
Cleric.description: Holy light runs along your weapon.

Necromancer.name: Grave Pact
Necromancer.description: Shadows rise to hold the foe for your blow.

Elementalist.name: Prismatic Burst
Elementalist.description: Every element at once, guided by your strike.

Druid.name: Thornbound
Druid.description: Roots seize the foe as you strike.

Myrmidon.name: Phalanx Rush
Myrmidon.description: Shoulder to shoulder, you drive through the line.

Monk.name: Thousand Palms
Monk.description: A storm of blows, perfectly in rhythm.

Beastmaster.name: Pack Hunt
Beastmaster.description: Beast, companion and you strike as one pack.

Kannagi.name: Spirit Binding Rite
Kannagi.description: A seal of light pins the foe for your blow.

Shinobi.name: Shadow Crossing
Shinobi.description: Two shadows cross; the foe never sees either.
